Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game prop concept sheet, one portable FLOOR DEHUMIDIFIER for an established painterly apartment game. Input image 1 is a MATERIAL AND RENDERING STYLE reference only: soft rounded forms, hand-painted ivory with broad delicate brush strokes and subtle wear. Do not include a bathtub. The device extracts moisture and collects water in a removable tank; no mist or vapor. Household scale roughly 55cm tall, wheeled on four small casters, sturdy carry handle, believable air intake and upper exhaust, accessible collection bucket, simple humidity dial and full-tank indicator. Softly rounded modeled forms, textured brush-painted surfaces, tactile seams and restrained aging. Neutral warm studio illumination, muted cream backdrop. Large front three-quarter view plus smaller rear three-quarter view of the SAME consistent design, feet/wheels fully visible. Clean concept-art presentation with no busy environment, no branding, no watermark. Text only a small concept letter.
Concept A: warm ivory rounded rectangular body, muted sage-green upper grille and control inset, gently domed top, dark recessed horizontal front intake louvers, lower front pull-out water bucket with a narrow water-level window, integrated recessed handle on top. Friendly modest domestic appliance, modest analog dial, no digital display. Clear intake vs tank separation. Label A.
